correctness.rationale: Exact count by fixed mask, binomial inclusion–exclusion formula, multivariate exponential formula, and Gaussian Wick identity agree independently. Complement symmetry and adjacent-weight recurrence follow by explicit moment factorization. Gaussian integration by parts proves a_m recurrence and its strict positivity for m>=2. Starting at n=4, alternating even positivity and odd strict-descent induction gives the claimed sign sectors and sharp least absolute multiplier at all n>=4; low-order rows prove all exceptional ranks. The included standalone verifier directly enumerated all 4094 characters at n<=11 and checked independent formulas through n<=60. No numerical experiment is presented as an unbounded proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-point location set is a canonical sufficient local profile of a random involution. Beyond known telephone numbers and central moments, the theorem completely classifies recoverability of XOR convolution for all sizes, discovers the odd/even spectral sign split, and identifies its exactly sharp Euclidean inverse amplification. The exact central-gap correspondence and all-order minimization are relevant to Boolean harmonic analysis of weighted combinatorial distributions rather than an arbitrary small finite slice.
